title: GTMS Manual Test Result
description: Schema for user-authored manual test result files.

test_case_hash.description: GTMS contract: SHA-256 hash of the test case file content at prime time (16 hex chars)

result.description: REQUIRED: test outcome recorded by the tester (null while freshly stamped)

title.description: Optional metadata: test case title snapshot at prime time

requirement.description: Optional metadata: requirement reference snapshot at prime time

priority.description: Optional metadata: test case priority snapshot at prime time

type.description: Optional metadata: test case type snapshot at prime time

branch.description: Optional metadata: git branch at prime time

executed_by.description: Identity that recorded the result (stamped by gtms-pass/fail/skip snippet)

executed_at.description: Timestamp when the result was recorded -- ISO 8601 local time, no timezone enforcement

defect.description: Defect identifiers linked to a fail result (e.g. JIRA ticket IDs)

skip_reason.description: Reason for skipping the test (paired with result: skip)

steps.description: Optional step-level results (null while freshly stamped)

defect.description: Defect identifiers linked to a failing step
